title: SE(2) Composition & Wheel-Odometry Integration
hints: compose: rotate b's translation by a's heading, then add: x = xa + cos(θa)·xb − sin(θa)·yb, y = ya + sin(θa)·xb + cos(θa)·yb, θ = wrap(θa + θb).
Exact arc for constant (v, ω): Δx = (v/ω)(sin(θ+ωdt) − sinθ), Δy = −(v/ω)(cos(θ+ωdt) − cosθ).
For |ω| < ~1e-9, use the straight-line limit Δx = v·dt·cosθ, Δy = v·dt·sinθ. Otherwise v/ω blows up.
